subject: Follow-up: LuminFin PII access audit samples & retention constraints
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jensen <alice.jensen@luminfin.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: LuminFin PII access audit samples & retention constraints

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. Quick recap of the items we covered and the next steps we agreed to: 

- Scope: you asked for an example export showing who accessed PII fields (name, SSN last 4, email) across the last 90 days for a small sample of accounts.
- Required fields (we'll include in the sample export): timestamp (ISO8601), actor_id (redwood user id), actor_role, action (read/write/export), object_type, object_id, field_names_accessed, request_id, source_ip (redacted per policy), region.
- Pseudonymization: per the call, we will hash identifiable values in the sample and provide a separate, encrypted mapping file only after a formal request/contract.
- Retention: you asked whether logs can be retained >90 days and whether we can export retention policy evidence. We can provide a written retention summary and an export covering the 90-day window; retention beyond 90 days is available with Dedicated/Private deployments or as an add-on.
- Residency: LuminFin requested that audit logs be kept within the US region. We can scope the sample to US-hosted logs and document the current storage region.

Action items: 
1) I will upload a sample CSV (tiny subset, hashed PII) and a short retention-policy summary by EOD tomorrow (Jul 16).
2) Neha will confirm what fields we redact vs pseudonymize and the secure transfer method for the mapping file.
3) Alice/Tom to confirm whether the sample should include session IDs and full source IPs (we can provide IPs partially masked if required).

Target completion: Jul 17 for confirmation, Jul 20 for any expanded exports if requested.

Attachments: I will attach the file names below when I send the export: access-audit-sample.csv (CSV, ~45KB), retention-policy-summary.pdf (PDF, ~120KB).

Thanks —
Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Alice Jensen <alice.jensen@luminfin.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@luminfin.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: LuminFin PII access audit samples & retention constraints

Marcus —

Appreciate the fast recap. A couple clarifications from our side before you pull the sample: 
- Please include session_id and source_ip in the sample if possible. If you must mask IPs for privacy, partial masking is fine (e.g., 192.0.xxx.xxx).
- We only need name and last4 for SSN in the sample; do not include full SSN.
- For the mapping file (hashed -> cleartext), we will need that under an executed NDA or per secure SFTP exchange — happy to sign what you need.

Tom will loop in procurement for any paperwork related to extended retention; for now, the sample and a written retention summary will be enough for our internal reviewers.

Thanks,
Alice
Product Security Manager, LuminFin
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jensen <alice.jensen@luminfin.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 13:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Follow-up: LuminFin PII access audit samples & retention constraints

Hi Alice —

Quick note from the security/compliance side on what we can provide and how: 

1) Export formats: CSV (columns as Marcus listed) and JSONL (one event per line). We will default to CSV unless you prefer JSONL for tooling.

2) PII handling: for the sample we will pseudonymize names and email addresses (SHA-256 salted hash). We can produce two variants: 
   - Redacted: PII columns replaced with "REDACTED"
   - Pseudonymized: hashed values with a mapping file stored separately.

3) IPs and session IDs: we can include source_ip with last octet masked by default; if LuminFin has a signed DPA/NDA and documented justification, we can deliver full source_ip for the sample via secure transfer. Session IDs will be included if you confirm they are needed for your audit.

4) Retention evidence: our standard hosted audit trail retention is configurable between 30–365 days. For the hosted plan you are evaluating we recommend an explicit retention policy (we will attach the retention-policy-summary.pdf). Dedicated/Private deployments can guarantee region-specific storage and longer retention windows (multi-year).

5) Secure transfer & controls: mapping files or cleartext extracts will be delivered via our secure SFTP endpoint and logged for chain-of-custody. We also offer an encrypted temporary-access Share (one-time download link) for smaller files.

Next steps I will take: prepare both CSV and JSONL samples, create the pseudonymized mapping file, and include a short README describing hashing salt handling and transfer method. I will reach out to your procurement contact (Tom) regarding any necessary paperwork.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jensen <alice.jensen@luminfin.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@luminfin.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Jul 2026 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: LuminFin PII access audit samples & retention constraints

Alice/Tom —

Attached are the sample artifacts we discussed: access-audit-sample.csv and retention-policy-summary.pdf. Notes: 
- access-audit-sample.csv: 50 rows, pseudonymized name/email columns (SHA-256), source_ip masked to last octet. Column list in header: timestamp, actor_id, actor_role, action, object_type, object_id, fields_accessed, session_id, source_ip, request_id, region.
- retention-policy-summary.pdf: short explainer of hosted vs dedicated retention windows, evidence generation, and steps to escalate to a 1yr+ retention commit.

Links: HubSpot deal LF-2026-03 has the mutual action plan and next milestone (https://app.redwood.ai/deals/LF-2026-03). If you want the cleartext mapping file we require an executed Data Exchange Addendum — I can send a DocuSign link or we can stage the mapping on secure SFTP after an NDA. Please advise preferred route.

Requested by: If you confirm the sample is sufficient, we'll mark the compliance checkpoint complete and move to pricing discussion next week.

Thanks —
Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- access-audit-sample.csv (CSV, 50KB)
- retention-policy-summary.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
